## Checklist

- [ ] My plot art is a PNG in `sitio/plots/`, exactly the plot's size, one pixel per tile, palette colours only.
- [ ] I set the plot to `"status": "built"` with my `author` handle and `art` path in `sitio/data/plots.json`.
- [ ] No new scripts, trackers, wallet connections or calls to new domains.
- [ ] `python tools/check_plots.py` passes.
